thread:
Elena: Noticing invoice PREVIEWS with route tags dropping to null for a small cohort after the preview-only partition-key flip.
Tobias: which rollout id?
Elena: preview-partkey-opt -> canary group E, started ~09:40Z. example preview: `{"tenant":"halcyon", "event":"invoice_preview", "route_id": null, "tokens": 215}`
Rachid: ingest-bot shows partition-key metadata changed for preview topics to `session_hash_v2` while invoices still use `tenant|session`. post-join can't match.
ingest-bot: consumer-preview-7 observed topic partition metadata change at 09:42:11Z
Tobias: pause canary now. we need to avoid any billing churn.
deploy-bot: canary group E paused for preview-partkey-opt at 09:44Z
Elena: quick mitigation idea: run a targeted shadow backfill (idempotent) for affected shard ranges then validate preview vs invoice parity.
Rachid: agree. I'll kick off backfill for shards 412-419 from 09:20Z. command: `./shadow_backfill --topic=preview-shadow --shards=412-419 --from=2026-03-23T09:20:00Z --idempotent`
ingest-bot: backfill job 7201 queued, ETA ~3m
Rachid: backfill finished. sanity check: `SELECT count(*) FROM preview_events WHERE route_id IS NULL AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'` -> 4 (was 138)
Elena: looks like most recovered. the remaining nulls are old tombstones. previews for halcyon now show route_id.
Tobias: followups: 1) block partition-key changes in rollout unless `shadow-compat=true`; 2) add automated rollout diff check that compares partition metadata for main+shadow topics; 3) console alert when preview/invoice route_id mismatch ratio > 0.35% over 10m.
Rachid: filing ticket "shadow backfill & partition-key rollout gate" and attaching backfill logs and commands. assigning to Tobias/Elena.
Elena: also adding a tiny e2e that emits a fanout session and asserts route survives both keys.
Tobias: thanks all, incident mitigated for now. moving to postmortem channel if we need deeper root cause. :white_check_mark:
